Prepare site plans and multiple siting options for granny flats / small second dwellings on existing residential lots.

Work from our checklists, Archistar outputs, survey/site plans, services information and client briefs.

Produce clean, accurate DWG and PDF files ready for our local architect to develop to building?permit level.

Coordinate with the Director and our existing VA via WhatsApp,

Essential Experience

Strong experience with Australian residential design and documentation (granny flats, new dwellings or extensions), including:

Must have experience with Melbourne / Victoria residential projects, such as small second dwellings, extensions, or new homes, specifically (ResCode, small lot housing, BMO, overlays, etc.).

Strong background in Australian residential design and documentation (granny flats, new dwellings or extensions).

Ability to interpret title plans, sewer / easement plans and apply them to siting decisions.

Strong understanding of energy rating and construction systems (timber framing, slab vs stumps).

Familiarity with Archistar or similar site analysis tools.

Solid understanding of:

National Construction Code (NCC) Vol 2/3 as it relates to low?rise housing.

Confident working in DWG (AutoCAD / Revit / ArchiCAD or similar) and exporting clean PDFs suitable for council/client concept packs.

Communication & Availability

title: Outbound Customer Success Agent
description:
Outbound Customer Success Agent



[Full-Time] [Remote] [Competitive Salary] [US Market]



Please fill out the form: 



About Goda



We are Goda, a fast-growing DTC brand in the fragrance and skincare space, selling across the US and globally. Our hero products have built a loyal customer base, and we're scaling fast.



We run paid social at high volume, bringing in new customers every day. Our Customer Success team plays a critical role in turning first-time buyers into long-term customers by proactively reaching out, building trust, addressing concerns, and creating positive customer experiences that drive retention.



This is not a traditional customer support role. We don't wait for customers to contact us — we proactively reach out to ensure they succeed with our products and remain engaged with our brand.



The Role



You'll be responsible for making outbound calls to customers across the US market. Your primary goal is to strengthen customer relationships, improve retention, reduce subscription churn, gather feedback, and ensure customers are getting the most value from their experience with Goda.



You'll work closely with our Customer Success and Operations teams, follow established workflows, and maintain detailed records of customer interactions within our systems.



You'll report directly to the Customer Success Manager and be measured against activity, quality, and retention-focused KPIs. We expect you to take ownership, identify customer trends, and surface opportunities that help improve both the customer experience and business performance.



What You'll Be Doing

Outbound Customer Engagement

• Making outbound calls to customers throughout the day to provide support, answer questions, and strengthen customer relationships

• Conducting proactive follow-ups with new customers to ensure a positive experience with their purchase

• Reaching out to subscription customers regarding upcoming renewals, account concerns, and retention opportunities

• Handling customer objections professionally and helping customers find solutions that fit their needs

• Gathering customer feedback and identifying recurring themes, concerns, or opportunities

• Maintaining accurate records of customer interactions, outcomes, and follow-up actions

• Building rapport with customers while representing the brand in a professional and customer-centric manner



Retention & Customer Success

• Identifying customers at risk of cancellation and proactively addressing concerns

• Supporting customer retention initiatives through personalized conversations and relationship-building

• Helping customers understand product benefits, subscription options, and available solutions

• Escalating complex customer concerns through the appropriate internal channels when necessary

• Working closely with leadership to surface customer insights that may improve retention and customer experience



Quality & Accountability

• Meeting daily outbound call targets and productivity expectations

• Maintaining high-quality conversations and customer satisfaction standards

• Following established processes while applying sound judgment when handling unique situations

• Contributing ideas that improve customer experience, call workflows, and team processes

• Taking ownership of customer outcomes rather than simply completing activities



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Prior outbound calling experience in a call center, sales, customer success, retention, or similar phone-based environment

• Comfortable handling high call volumes (40–50 outbound calls per day)

• Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-accented communication style

• Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone

• Resilient, confident, and comfortable handling objections, rejection, and difficult conversations

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail when documenting customer interactions

• Proactive mindset — you identify opportunities and problems before they become larger issues



Nice to Have

• Experience working with subscription-based DTC or e-commerce brands

• Experience with retention, customer success, or subscription management

• Familiarity with CRM, dialer, or customer communication platforms

• Experience supporting US-based customers



Instant No's

• Discomfort with high-volume outbound calling

• Poor verbal communication or difficulty building rapport over the phone

• Lack of ownership when customer issues arise

• Failure to document customer interactions accurately

• Inability to handle rejection or maintain professionalism during challenging conversations

• Waiting to be told what to do instead of proactively taking action



How We Measure Your Performance

• Daily outbound call activity and productivity metrics

• Customer retention and subscription save performance

• Quality assurance scores and call reviews

• Customer satisfaction and feedback

• Accuracy of customer records and follow-up completion

• Consistency in meeting team KPIs and operational standards



Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Fully remote position

• Opportunity to work with a fast-growing DTC brand serving customers across the US

• Clear career growth opportunities within Customer Success and Retention

• Structured training, SOPs, and support systems

We design and build purpose-built rooming houses for sophisticated property investors across Queensland and Victoria, and we've completed 30+ projects so far. Our website is built on Webflow and is the engine that turns serious investors into enquiries, so it needs to look sharp, load fast, and rank well.

The Role

Part-time / project-based to start. Potential to grow into an ongoing retainer.



You'll be working on:

- A new static Investors page and a new dynamic News page (Webflow CMS collection)

- Converting our Projects page to infinite scroll

- Fixing a CMS image gallery binding issue

- Ongoing SEO (meta titles/descriptions, page speed, structured data, internal linking)

- Regular CMS content updates and proactive site maintenance (broken links, slow pages, image issues)



What You Need

+ Expert-level Webflow Designer and Webflow CMS skills

+ Strong on-page and technical SEO knowledge (page speed, Core Web Vitals, structured data)

+ Image optimisation, responsive design, Google Search Console

+ 2–3+ years hands-on Webflow experience with a portfolio of real client sites

+ Available during at least part of AEST/AEDT business hours



Nice to have: Google Analytics, basic HTML/CSS, JavaScript



You'll Fit Well If You:

+ Take pride in detail and catch issues before being asked

+ Can execute from a written brief without needing a call

+ Treat SEO as a real discipline, not a checkbox

+ Communicate proactively (no disappearing between tasks!)



How to Apply

1. Start your application with the word "Co-living".

2. Share 2–3 live Webflow websites you personally built or maintain. Briefly describe your involvement in each project.

3. What is your hourly rate (PHP)?

4. How many hours per week are you available?

7. Attach an updated CV.

title: Long-Form Video Editor — YouTube (Vlog / Talking-Head / Whiteboard)
description:
## Who I Am



I'm Basit Oyebanji. In the last 18 months, I've collected over $2.7M in the online sales space. I run a group mentorship and a 1:1 intensive called The Haven Freedom Protocol — helping athletes and 9-5 workers earn 3-10k+/month online in 90 days or less.



I'm not a guru with a microphone. I walked the path first. Now I coach people through it.



I already have a full team running — SDR, content strategist, strategic advisor, calendar manager, and a creative director handling content systems. This isn't a one-man startup. It's a real operation being scaled intentionally.



---



## Why I'm Hiring You



There's no dedicated long-form editor on the team yet. The YouTube channel is being built properly — and I need someone who actually understands what that means.



This isn't "cut out the silences and add some music." Long-form is storytelling. It's retention. It's the thing that turns a stranger into a believer before they ever book a call.



I need someone who feels the pacing, knows when to hold a 
nt and when to cut, and can make a 15-minute vlog feel like it flew past.



The channel is young. That means whoever comes in now helps build the standard — not inherit someone else's template.



---



## What You'll Edit



- **YouTube vlogs** — travel, training, behind-the-scenes (Cape Town, Barcelona, Miami, Lagos)

- **Talking-head / whiteboard breakdowns** — sales frameworks, mindset, athlete-to-business mapping

- **Podcast-style edits** — guest conversations, long-form interviews

- **Cinematic, natural light, documentary feel** — not glossy ad, not flat studio



---



## What I Need From You



- **You've edited long-form before.** YouTube, documentary, vlog — format doesn't matter as much as proof you can hold pacing across 10–20 minutes without losing people.

- **You communicate cleanly.** If you're going to miss a deadline, you tell me *before* it's missed. Not after.

- **You get the brief without it being repeated five times.** Watch the raw footage. Feel the story. Know what belongs and what doesn't.

- **You take feedback without ego.** The first few videos will have back-and-forth. That's normal. Revision is refinement, not criticism.

- **You're consistent.** Video 10 should be better than video 1 — not a coin flip.



---



## What Success Looks Like



- **30 days** — first batch delivered on time. Revisions minimal. I can trust the process.

- **90 days** — channel has a clear visual identity. Retention trending up. I hand you raw footage and trust it'll come back right.

- **6 months** — you know the brand as well as anyone on the team. Proactively flagging what's working. The channel is compounding.



---



## How To Apply



**? Apply here:** Long-Form Video Editor Application





The form takes 8–10 minutes. Some questions will make you think — that's intentional.



It includes a **sample edit** using my footage + a **short Loom recording** introducing yourself. Both are required.



No templates. No copy-paste answers. I read every application personally.

title: Virtual Assistant for Simon Mariner - Business Development Support | Leadership Communication Practice
description:
About the role:

This is a research, outreach and pipeline support role for a senior leadership communication coach working with CEOs, Chairs and Executive teams at Australia's largest organisations — with a growing presence in the UK and US.

The VA works closely with Simon to build and manage a targeted business development pipeline. The role is operational but requires genuine marketing intelligence — you need to understand what you're doing and why, not just execute tasks.



What you'll own:

Target list building and maintenance. Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo.io to identify and track Chief Talent Officers, CHROs, and Heads of Talent at ASX 200 companies and large private organisations. Keeping the list current as people change roles.



Trigger monitoring. Setting up and monitoring alerts for events that create outreach opportunities — new executive appointments, company restructures, CEO succession announcements, ASX results, leadership offsites, industry events. Flagging these daily with a brief note on relevance.



Outreach drafting. Writing personalised LinkedIn connection requests and follow-up messages for Simon's review and approval. Each message references a specific trigger or piece of research. Never generic. Never templated beyond a light framework.



Pipeline tracking. Maintaining a simple CRM or spreadsheet tracking every prospect, outreach sent, response received, and next action required. Weekly pipeline summary to Simon.



LinkedIn support. Scheduling approved content posts. Monitoring engagement — who liked, commented, shared — and flagging warm signals for follow-up.



Research. Pre-meeting research on prospects and their organisations. One-page briefing notes before any qualifying conversation.



Calendar and scheduling. Managing meeting requests and scheduling once a prospect responds positively.



Admin support. Invoicing, session scheduling, and general office administration as the practice grows.



What you need:

Excellent written English. Your outreach drafts need to sound like a senior Australian professional, not a template. This is the most important skill in the role.



LinkedIn fluency. You know how Sales Navigator works. You understand how to search, filter, and build lists. You know the difference between a connection request and a DM and when to use each.



Research instinct. You can scan a company's news, LinkedIn page, and ASX announcements and identify what matters in under ten minutes.



Marketing understanding. You understand what a sales funnel is, what a lead is, what a trigger event is, and why personalisation matters. You don't need to be a marketer — you need to think like one.



Discretion. You will be working with confidential client names and commercially sensitive information. This is non-negotiable.



Proactivity. Simon is a senior practitioner, not a micromanager. You flag things, you suggest things, you solve problems before they become problems.



Tools. Comfortable with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Google Workspace, and a simple CRM or Notion. Willing to learn new tools quickly.



What success looks like in the first 90 days:

A clean, researched target list of 100+ CTOs and CHROs at relevant Australian organisations. A working trigger monitoring system. Ten to fifteen outreach messages sent per week on Simon's behalf, each personalised and approved. A pipeline tracker that Simon can read in five minutes and know exactly where every prospect stands.



APPLICATION TASK - PLEASE COMPLETE BEFORE SUBMITTING - otherwise application will no be considered.

This task is mandatory. Applications without a completed task will not be considered. It should take no more than 30 minutes.



The scenario

You are working as a Virtual Assistant for Simon Mariner, a senior leadership communication coach based in Sydney, Australia. Simon works exclusively with CEOs, Chairs and Executive Leadership Teams at major organisations, helping them communicate with greater impact, clarity and presence. His clients have included the incoming CEO of Westpac and the newly appointed Global CEO of KPMG.

Simon charges $25,000 AUD per engagement and does not discount. He is not a sales trainer, not a presentation coach in the traditional sense, and not a motivational speaker. He is a C-suite strategic communications specialist.

You have identified the following trigger event while monitoring LinkedIn this morning:

Sarah Chen has just been announced as the new Chief People Officer at Suncorp Group, one of Australia's largest financial services companies. She starts in the role in four weeks. Her LinkedIn profile shows she previously held a senior HR leadership role at NAB for six years.



Your task

Write two things:

1. A LinkedIn connection request from Simon to Sarah (300 characters maximum — this is LinkedIn's limit for connection requests). It must reference the trigger, feel personal and warm, and not pitch anything. It should make Sarah want to accept.

2. A follow-up direct message from Simon to Sarah (no more than 150 words), to be sent 5 days after she accepts the connection request. This message should reference something specific about her new role or the challenges facing a new CPO in financial services right now. It should open a door without pushing through it. No pitch. No call to action beyond a light invitation to connect.



What we're looking for

We are not looking for perfect. We are looking for instinct. Can you write in a senior professional's voice? Can you make something feel personal rather than templated? Can you identify what matters to the person you're writing to rather than talking about Simon?

Applications that sound like AI wrote them will not progress. Applications that sound like a human who understands the brief will.



How to submit

Paste both pieces of writing directly into your application message along with a brief note (no more than 100 words) explaining your approach — why you wrote what you wrote.

title: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Title: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant



Employment Type: Gig, project-based with potential to extend to part-time ongoing



Hours: 5 hours per day, Monday through Friday



About Me



I am a Senior Talent Acquisition professional based in the United States with 20 years of experience supporting major financial institutions and global organizations. I am conducting a confidential job search and need a skilled, reliable VA to manage my entire LinkedIn outreach campaign from research through execution. I have a 10-year-old LinkedIn account with 6,000+ connections and an active LinkedIn Sales Navigator subscription.



Everything strategic is already done. My messaging templates are written and organized by industry. My target company lists are built. My tracking spreadsheet is set up. What I need is someone who can take all of that and run it independently every day with zero hand-holding.



Your Exact Daily Responsibilities



Research and Lead List Building (approximately 1 to 1.5 hours)



Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, search for the right contacts at each target company on my provided list. Filter by company name, target title keywords, and seniority level I will specify. Verify that each contact’s current title matches my target criteria before adding them to the daily lead list. Log all identified contacts in our shared Google Sheet with their full name, company, current title, and LinkedIn profile URL before beginning outreach.



Send Connection Requests (approximately 1.5 to 2 hours)



Send 40 connection requests per day using my exact provided templates. Each template is specific to an industry section. You will replace only the bracketed fields, the contact’s first name. No other wording changes under any circumstances. Log each request in the tracking sheet immediately after sending, including contact name, company, title, industry section, date sent, and status marked as Pending. Do not exceed 50 connection requests in a single day.



Monitor Accepted Connections and Send Follow-Ups (approximately 30 minutes)



Check LinkedIn notifications daily for newly accepted connections. Send the follow-up message within 24 hours of acceptance using the exact industry-specific template I provide. Replace only the bracketed fields for first name and company name. Log the follow-up in the tracking sheet with date sent and status updated to Follow-Up Sent.



Monitor Replies and Flag to Me Immediately (approximately 30 minutes)



Check LinkedIn messages for any replies from contacts. Do not respond to any reply under any circumstances. The moment anyone replies, flag it to me immediately via WhatsApp with the contact’s full name, company, and the exact text of their message. Mark their status in the tracking sheet as Reply Received with the date. I handle all conversations personally from that point forward.



Daily Summary and Next Day Prep (approximately 30 minutes)



Send me a brief daily WhatsApp or
 update at the end of each session covering the following. How many contacts were researched and added to the lead list. How many connection requests were sent and to whom. How many follow-up messages were sent and to whom. Any replies received and from whom. Any issues encountered including title mismatches, profiles that could not be found, or any LinkedIn restriction or warning notices.



Use the remaining time to pull tomorrow’s target companies and begin preliminary research so the next day starts efficiently.



What You Will Never Do



Never respond to any reply or message from a contact. Never modify the provided message templates. Never connect with anyone outside the approved target company list without my explicit written approval. Never send more than 50 connection requests in a single day. Never make any changes to my LinkedIn profile, settings, biography, photo, or account information of any kind.



Tools You Will Use



LinkedIn Sales Navigator, access provided by me. Shared Google Sheet for daily tracking, set up by me. WhatsApp for daily communication and urgent reply flagging.



You Are the Right Person If You



Have hands-on experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator for lead research and outreach. Have supported a professional job search campaign or B2B LinkedIn outreach campaign before. Can follow written instructions precisely and consistently without improvising or taking initiative beyond your defined scope. Have strong professional English, sharp attention to detail, and zero tolerance for errors in names or company details. Are available Monday through Friday and can commit to five focused hours per day for the duration of the project. Communicate proactively if something is unclear rather than guessing. Have experience supporting HR, recruiting, legal, financial services, or other professional services clients.



How This Engagement Works



This starts as a two week paid gig. If your work is strong and the campaign is generating results, this converts to an ongoing part-time role for the duration of my job search. Before your first day I will provide complete access to all tools, all templates, all target lists, and the tracking sheet. We will do a 30 minute onboarding call via Zoom to walk through everything together so there are no questions on day one.



To Apply



Do not send a generic proposal. It will not be read.



Tell me specifically what LinkedIn Sales Navigator research or outreach work you have done before. Give me one concrete example: who you did it for, what the daily scope was, and what the outcome was. If you have supported a job search or recruiting outreach campaign specifically, describe it in detail.



Include your availability to start.



Applications without a specific example and a stated rate will not be considered.



Sales Navigator proficiency is non-negotiable for this role.

Experience running newsletter or content production for a brand or creator is highly valued. Approximately three to five hours per week to begin, likely growing as the publishing cadence increases. Ongoing, with a view to a long-term working relationship.

title: UI/UX Designer (Figma)
description:
UI/UX Designer (Figma)

Part-time | Remote | ~20 hours/week | Long-term engagement



About Us

We are a mobile app development and fractional CTO consultancy that works with startups and growing businesses to build products that are technically solid and genuinely well-designed. We partner closely with our clients across the full product lifecycle, from strategy and design through to development and launch.

We are growing our team and looking for a UI/UX designer who can work across multiple client projects with us on an ongoing basis.



The Role

We need a UI/UX designer to own Figma design work across our client projects, primarily focused on iOS mobile apps. You will work closely with our project managers, engineers, and clients to translate product ideas into clean, buildable designs that follow Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.

This is not a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it work, make it make sense, and make sure we're building the right thing" role.



What You Will Actually Be Doing

- Owning and maintaining Figma design systems across client projects (component libraries, color tokens, typography, spacing, corner radii)

- Designing and iterating on iOS app screens across full user journeys

- Translating product ideas into wireframes and high-fidelity mockups

- Working within Apple's UI guidelines and using standard iOS components and libraries

- Attending regular check-ins with our internal team and client stakeholders

- Flagging when a design direction won't work technically or won't make sense to users

- Helping the team prioritize which ideas are worth designing now vs. later



What We Are Looking For

On the technical side:

- Strong Figma skills including component libraries, auto layout, and design tokens

- Solid understanding of iOS design patterns and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines

- Experience designing mobile apps, not just websites

- Ability to hand off clean, organized files that an engineer can actually build from

- Familiarity with design systems and how global changes (theming, sizing) work in Figma

- On the personality side, this is equally important:

- You are direct. If an idea won't work, you say so clearly and explain why.

- You are proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see a gap and you fill it.

- You are confident enough to push back. Our clients are passionate and move fast. We need someone who can channel that energy into good design decisions, not just execute everything thrown at them.

- You can tell the difference between a good idea that needs refining and an idea that needs to be set aside for now.

- You communicate clearly in writing. Most of our collaboration happens async.



What This Is Not

This is not a role for someone who just does what they are told

This is not a role for someone who needs everything figured out before they can start

This is not a role for someone who treats every client idea as equally worth designing



Nice to Have

Experience working directly with non-technical clients or founders in a startup environment

Familiarity with health, wellness, or lifestyle apps

Experience designing for accessibility (contrast, font sizing, Apple accessibility standards)



Logistics

Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week to start

Long-term engagement if it's a good fit

Payment in USD



How to Apply

Please send the following:

Your portfolio (Figma files preferred, not just screenshots)

A brief note (3-5 sentences) on how you handle it when a client asks you to design something you think is a bad idea

Your availability and rate

We read every application. We will not respond to applications without a portfolio.

title: AI Ad Videos Specialist
description:
Read This Before You Apply!



This role is NOT for someone who is just getting started with AI video tools or still learning the basics. We work with paying clients whose businesses depend on real ad performance. If you cannot point to specific campaigns you have directly contributed to — with real results — please do not apply. We respect your time and ask that you respect ours.



About This Opportunity

We are a growing performance creative agency that helps e-commerce and direct-response brands scale their paid advertising on Meta and TikTok. Our core value proposition is simple: we give clients the creative firepower — volume, speed, and strategy — that their in-house teams can't match.



We are building an elite team of AI-powered creative specialists who can produce high-converting ad creatives at scale. We are not hiring a video editor. We are not hiring someone to make things look pretty. We are hiring someone who understands why ads work and can use AI tools to produce, test, and iterate on those ads faster than any traditional production team.



 The Role:

As our AI Ad Video Creative Specialist, you will be responsible for producing scroll-stopping video ad creatives that are engineered to convert. You will work directly from creative briefs that specify the target audience, offer, desired hook angles, and performance benchmarks. Your job is to translate those briefs into finished video ads — and to bring your own creative intelligence to the process.



This is not a set-it-and-forget-it role. The best performers here will be proactive about suggesting new angles, flagging creative fatigue early, and thinking about why something did or did not perform — not just executing and delivering files.



 What You Will Do:

Produce 15–40 video ad variations per client per month using AI-assisted production workflows



Develop multiple hook variations for each core offer (different emotional angles, formats, and openings)



Work from direct response briefs and translate them into finished, platform-ready ad creatives (Meta Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts formats)



Maintain strict brand guidelines while pushing creative variety



Deliver creatives with clear naming conventions tied to hook angle and target audience for easy split testing



Participate in performance review sessions — you must be able to look at CTR and ROAS data and draw intelligent creative conclusions from it



Recommend creative iterations based on what is and is not working in the data



Turn around revisions quickly and without friction

---



 Non-Negotiable:

Every applicant must be able to demonstrate all of the following. If you cannot, please do not apply.



Requirements and What We Mean:

| Proven AI video ad production:- You have used tools like Runway, Kling, Pika, HeyGen, CapCut AI, or equivalent to produce finished ad creatives — not experiments or personal projects, but real ads for real clients or brands.



| Direct response marketing understanding:- You know what a hook is and why the first 3 seconds determine everything. You understand offers, CTAs, and the difference between brand awareness and performance creative. 



| Portfolio of real ad creatives:- You can show us finished video ads you have made — ideally with context on what they were trying to achieve and what happened when they ran. 



| Platform-specific formatting knowledge | You know the difference between a Meta Reel creative and a TikTok ad creative. You understand aspect ratios, caption placement, and what gets ads flagged.



| Basic ad metrics literacy:- You know what CTR, CPM, ROAS, and hook rate mean and can discuss them intelligently without needing an explanation. 



| Reliable delivery and communication | You meet deadlines. You communicate proactively if something is delayed. YOU DO NOT DISAPPEAR!



 Ideal Background:

We are not asking for a degree or a specific job title. We are looking for evidence of capability. The following backgrounds tend to produce the strongest applicants:



 Freelance performance creative producer



 Media buyer or paid social specialist who also produces their own creatives



 UGC content creator who has made the pivot into direct response and ad production



 Creative strategist at a digital marketing or performance agency



 Independent video producer specialising in e-commerce or DTC brand ads



What matters far more than your background is your portfolio and your answers to the application questions below.



---



 Tools & Tech:

You should already be proficient in at least several of the following. We are not going to train you on these tools — you should come ready to use them.



 AI video generation: Runway Gen-3, Kling, Pika, Luma Dream Machine, or equivalent



 AI voiceover / lip sync: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Captions.ai, or equivalent



 Video editing: CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or equivalent



 Scriptwriting and hook ideation: Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent



 Static ad support: Canva, Adobe Express, Photoshop (for thumbnail frames and overlays)



 File management and delivery: Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion, or equivalent



---



 Compensation:



 Pay is competitive and commensurate with your experience and output quality.



 Structure: Project-based or monthly retainer depending on workload and fit.



 Rate: Discussed during the interview process based on your portfolio and capacity.



 Availability: We prioritise candidates who can commit to consistent weekly output, not one-off projects.



 Location: Fully remote. All time zones considered.



---



 How to Apply:



Read every word of this section. The application process is intentionally selective. We are looking for people who follow instructions precisely, communicate clearly, and take the work seriously. The application itself is the first test.



Step 1 — Do NOT send a CV or resume

We do not want your CV. We do not care where you went to school or what your job titles have been. We care about what you can actually produce. A CV will not help your application — it may hurt it.



Step 2 — Gather Your Top 3 Video Ad Creatives

Select the three video ad creatives you are most proud of. These should be finished ads — not demo reels, not mood boards, not personal content. Real ads, made for a real product or client. For each creative, prepare the following:

 A direct link to the video (YouTube unlisted, Vimeo, Google Drive, Dropbox — no download-gated links)



 One sentence on what the ad was trying to do (product, audience, goal)



 One sentence on what tools you used to produce it



 Any performance data you are able to share (optional but valued)



Step 3 — Answer These Questions in Your

Copy these questions into your
 and answer each one directly. Do not write an essay. Be specific and direct. Vague answers will not progress.



1. Describe your current AI video production workflow from brief to final file. What tools do you use at each stage?



2. What is the biggest mistake you see other AI video creators make when producing ad creatives? Why does it matter?



3. A client's ad creative is getting a strong thumb-stop rate (hook rate above 35%) but a poor click-through rate. What does that tell you, and what would you change?



4. What is the maximum number of finished video ad variations you could produce in a week if given a detailed creative brief, assuming you were working on this full-time?



5. Give one example of a creative decision you made — a hook angle, a format choice, a structural element — that you believe directly improved an ad's performance. Be specific.



Step 4 — The

 Begin your
 with the words: CREATIVE FIRST.

 This tells us you read the full posting. Applications that do not begin with these exact words will be deleted without being read, regardless of the quality of the work inside.



Send your application to: everythingagencyhq at gmail dot com (remove the spaces inbetween and use the correct address)



Subject line: AI Ad Video Specialist



Your
 should contain:

 The words CREATIVE FIRST at the very beginning

 Your three video ad creative links with the required context for each

 Your answers to all five questions above

 Your general availability and weekly capacity

 Your preferred rate or range (optional at this stage)



 What Happens Next

We review every application that follows these instructions. If your work and answers stand out, we will reach out to schedule a short video call. 



Strong applicants may be offered a test project before any ongoing engagement is confirmed. We believe in evaluating people on real work, not interviews alone.



 One Final Note:



 We are building something serious and we are looking for someone who is equally serious about this craft. If you have been producing AI-powered ad creatives, staying close to what performs, and thinking like a marketer — this is the kind of work you will thrive in. If this is something you have been casually experimenting with, this is not the right fit yet.



 We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Video Editor (Real Estate YouTube) — Part-Time, Ongoing
description:
Video Editor (Real Estate YouTube) — Part-Time, Ongoing



We're Local Station. We produce local real-estate video content for real estate agents — neighborhood tours, market updates, and listing walkthroughs that get published to the agent's YouTube channel. We're looking for a dependable part-time editor to join our production queue on an ongoing, per-video basis. Steady repeat work, growing over time, with room to become our go-to editor.



This is project-based: you pick up jobs from our queue as they come in, edit them, and deliver. The better and faster you are, the more volume (and pay) comes your way.



WHAT EACH JOB LOOKS LIKE:

- You get raw footage an agent uploaded (talking-head + b-roll), a separately recorded audio track, any images they want included, and the agent's headshot + logo

- You cut it into a polished 4-8 minute video

- Sync the separate audio track to the video

- Clean up the audio (remove noise, even out levels), tighten pacing, trim filler — while keeping the agent sounding natural, not robotic

- Add a branded intro/outro and lower-thirds using the agent's headshot and logo

- Add on-screen captions and CORRECT them (names, neighborhoods, and street names must be spelled right)

- Deliver a finished MP4 (1080p minimum, 4K preferred)

- Deliver a clean, corrected transcript of the finished video (see below)



THE TRANSCRIPT IS REQUIRED ON EVERY JOB:

Every video must come with a clean transcript of what's actually said in THAT video — the kind Descript generates that you then tidy up (fixing names, places, and errors). It must match the final cut and be the real spoken words of the video. Never copy it from a script or another source. This is non-negotiable.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Know transcript-based editing well (Descript strongly preferred) plus a polish editor (CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Premiere)

- Have strong written English (you'll be correcting transcripts and captions)

- Have a portfolio with talking-head / YouTube-style edits — real estate, vlog, or corporate is ideal

- Can reliably hit a ~48-hour turnaround per video

- Communicate clearly and flag problems early



PAY & SETUP:

- Per-video pay, paid via Wise or PayPal (no platform fees taken from you)

- We'll agree your rate after a short PAID test video

- Part-time and ongoing — a long-term relationship for the right person, with growing volume



HOW TO APPLY:

Put the word NEIGHBORHOOD at the very top of your reply so we know you read this. Then send:

1) A link to your portfolio/reel that includes at least one talking-head edit

2) The editing tools you use (do you use Descript?)

3) Your per-video rate

4) Your realistic turnaround time per video



Applications without a portfolio link, or without the word NEIGHBORHOOD, won't be reviewed.

title: AI Content Strategist & YouTube Retention Specialist
description:
AI Content Strategist & YouTube Retention Specialist (Biblical History)



Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Performance Bonuses Available



We operate a high-volume YouTube network focused on Biblical history, archaeology, and ancient civilizations, with plans to expand into Roman history and the Middle Ages.



Important



We are not looking for a traditional scriptwriter who starts from a blank page.



Our workflow is AI-first.



We are looking for someone who knows how to use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools to generate strong first drafts, improve prompts over time, and refine scripts so they hold viewer attention.



What You'll Do



- Use AI tools to create and improve long-form documentary scripts.

- Continuously refine prompts and workflows to produce better outputs.

- Review AI-generated scripts and make final adjustments before production.

- Improve hooks, pacing, and narrative flow to increase viewer retention.

- Analyze YouTube audience retention graphs and apply lessons to future scripts.

- Help us build systems that make every batch of scripts stronger than the last.



What We're Looking For



- Excellent written English.

- Strong experience using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other AI tools.

- Understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience psychology.

- Interest in Biblical history, archaeology, theology, or historical documentaries.

- Familiarity with YouTube analytics, audience retention, and CTR is a major advantage.

- Strong attention to detail and clear communication.



Hours



Initial phase:



10–15 hours per week for approximately 4–8 weeks.



Long-term:



Approximately 3–5 hours per week as systems mature.



Pay



- $7–10 USD/hour depending on experience.

- Long-term opportunity with performance bonuses.



Performance Bonuses



As channel metrics improve, additional monthly bonuses are available.



Examples include:



- Sustained improvements in CTR and Average View Duration.

- Reaching major channel milestones.

- Successful expansion into future history channels.



How to Apply



Start the first line of your application with:



Mesopotamia



Then answer this question:



A viewer clicks on a Biblical history video but leaves after 15 seconds. What would you change in the opening of the script to keep them watching past 3 minutes?



We are looking for thoughtful answers rather than perfect ones.



This is a long-term role for someone who enjoys AI, storytelling, and building systems that continually improve over time.

We serve 131,000 users every year, we're profitable, and we've been around for over a decade. Now we're expanding to more elite universities around the world — and we want you on the team to help make it happen.

You'll learn what it actually takes to scale an online marketplace — not in theory, but by doing it.

title: Paid Media Specialist (Google & Meta Ads)
description:

Industry: Digital Advertising & Performance Marketing



Employment Type: Full-Time & Freelancer



I. About EasyScale



EasyScale  is a results-driven digital advertising agency specializing in performance marketing and scalable growth strategies. We partner with brands to deliver measurable impact through data-led campaigns across paid media, social platforms, and digital ecosystems. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through strategic execution and continuous optimization.

 & Instagram) platforms.



This role is instrumental in driving qualified leads, customer acquisition, and revenue growth through strategic planning, hands-on execution, and continuous performance optimization.

Plan, execute, and manage paid media campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads platforms.

Experience with performance tracking, reporting, and analytics tools.

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

Opportunity to work with diverse industries and growing brands.

title: Freelance CRM Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Freelance CRM Specialist to join our team on a contract basis. You will take ownership of our Klaviyo CRM environment — auditing its current state, optimising our customer data flows, and driving measurable improvements in engagement and retention. This is a hands-on, results-driven role suited to a self-starter who knows CRM best practice inside out.



Rate: $7–$30/hr

Hours: 8–16 hrs/week



What You Will Do

• CRM Audit: Conduct a thorough audit of our existing Klaviyo setup — lists, segments, flows, campaigns, deliverability health, and data integrity — and deliver a prioritised findings report with clear recommendations.

• Strategy & Optimisation: Develop and execute a CRM roadmap covering segmentation, automation flows, A/B testing, and lifecycle campaigns to improve open rates, click rates, and revenue attribution.

• Klaviyo Management: Build, manage, and optimise
 and SMS automations, templates, and audience segments within Klaviyo.

• Data & Integrations: Ensure clean, accurate customer data; manage integrations between Klaviyo and our e-commerce/tech stack; set up proper tracking and UTM parameters.

• Reporting: Provide regular performance reports with actionable insights — deliverability, engagement metrics, revenue impact, and list health.

• Compliance: Ensure all CRM activity is compliant with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and other relevant regulations including list hygiene and opt-out management.



Requirements

• Proven experience as a CRM Specialist,
 Marketing Specialist, or similar role (minimum 3 years)

• Hands-on, demonstrable expertise with Klaviyo (required)

• Experience performing CRM audits and producing clear, actionable audit reports

• Strong understanding of
 marketing fundamentals: deliverability, segmentation, personalisation, A/B testing

• Familiarity with CRM data structures, customer lifecycle stages, and retention strategies

• Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for
 template customisation

• Experience with e-commerce integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar is a plus)

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data, interpreting metrics, and translating insights into action

• Understanding of GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and
 compliance best practices

title: YouTube Video Editor – Comedy Cooking Show
description:
About the Project



We are launching Grub, an energetic comedy cooking channel that blends a high-stakes culinary format with raw, backyard Aussie humor. Think MasterChef meets The Office or Sidemen cooking challenges.



The channel is run with 5 years of experience managing successful YouTube channels. I deeply understand the editing workflow, respect the craft, and am looking for a dedicated editor to collaborate with long-term. Once we establish a creative shorthand and a style we both love, you will have complete creative freedom over the cuts.



The Role & First Project



Our debut episode is fully filmed, and a 28-minute rough cut is already mapped out.



The Goal: Take the rough cut and transform it into a tight, fast-paced, highly engaging 12–18 minute polished YouTube video.



The Style: Sharp comedic timing, deadpan cuts to reaction shots, sudden snap-zooms, and clever audio/music cutouts to punctuate the humor.



What we DO NOT want: Over-the-top, flashy, TikTok-style text graphics popping up every second. The comedy should stem from the timing, human expressions, and pacing.



Technical Details: The raw audio, sound design, and pacing are unpolished. If you are not fully confident with color grading, don't worry—I can provide you with pre-graded footage, allowing you to focus purely on the edit and sound.



What We Are Looking For

YouTube Fluent: A strong grasp of YouTube pacing, storytelling, and audience retention strategies.



Software Requirements: Experience working inside Adobe Premiere Pro is required so we can easily exchange project files, assets, or XMLs if needed.



Creative Autonomy: The ability to work independently, find the funny moments in the footage, and pitch/inject your own jokes and comedic timing into the timeline.



Time Zone Alignment: Ability to occasionally communicate during Australian daytime hours (AEST / GMT+10) for asset handoffs and brief feedback loops.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit your application with the following:



Portfolio: A link to your portfolio or reel, specifically highlighting your best work regarding comedic timing, sound design, or pacing.



Software Check: Confirm you are using Adobe Premiere Pro (or let us know if you utilize an XML-supported workflow).

mbers, and lead our delivery division

mber and grow with us

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Premium Men's Grooming Brand (DTC)
description:
About Us



We're a premiu
n's grooming brand (beard care) based in Australia, selling direct-to-consumer. We're not a cheap, hype-y dropship brand — we're masculine, clean, premium, and results-driven. Our content has to feel that way too.



We're building a consistent short-form content pipeline (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and need a reliable editor who can turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, on-brand videos — week in, week out.



What You'll Be Doing

- Editing short-form videos (15–60s) for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts from raw talking-head and product footage

- Matching an annotated master reference video — we'll show you exactly the style, pacing, and structure to replicate. This is reference-match editing, not freelancing your own style each time.

- Applying our locked brand kit (colours, fonts, caption style) consistently to every video

- Producing videos on a content calendar — consistent volume, on deadline

- Working through feedback in rounds and refining quickly



Must-Have Skills

- Fluent in Premiere Pro and After Effects

- Proven short-form editing experience (please show short-form work specifically — not weddings, not corporate)

- Retention-led pacing — strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds, no dead air, 
ntum held to the end

- Punchy, animated captions and subtitles — readable on mute, on-brand

- Sound design and beat-syncing — cuts that land on the beat, SFX that punctuate

- Hook and B-roll instinct — knows how to open, when to cut to product, how to layer B-roll

- Brand preset discipline — applies our colours and fonts correctly every time, without being reminded

- Reference-match editing — can faithfully replicate a reference video, consistently

- Premium feel — clean, masculine, considered. NOT over-stickered, 
-heavy, or hype-y CapCut style.

VERY IMPORTANT:

- Repurposing range — can take our existing B-roll and older footage and build fresh 20–30s shorts from it. We need both speeds: quick, high-volume edits when we need output, AND premium, polished repurposing when the brief calls for it. What we DON'T want is the lazy approach — just slapping a voiceover or talking head over old clips and calling it done. Even fast edits must still hit the hook, pacing, and brand standard.



Also Important

- Can produce consistent output on a calendar (not just one-off projects)

- Takes feedback in rounds without friction

- Reliable communication — responsive, clear, hits deadlines





IMPORTANT — Brand Rules (please read before applying)

We have a strict halal sound requirement: we only use vocals-only or percussion-only audio — NO instrumental music. You will work from a curated sound library we provide. If you're used to dropping trending instrumental tracks on everything, this role will not suit you. Please confirm in your application that you've read and understand this rule.



How to Apply

- To apply, please send:



1. Your short-form portfolio (links to TikTok/Reels/Shorts edits you've done — ideally similar pacing/style to premium brands)

2. What software you edit in and how many short-form videos you can comfortably deliver per week

3. Your answer to this: What makes a short-form video hold a viewer past the first 3 seconds? (2–3 sentences, your own words)

4. At the top of your application, write the word GROWTH so we know you read this full post.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test edit (we'll pay you for it) using our real footage, reference video, and brand kit. This is how we make our final decision.



We're looking for a long-term tea
mber, not a one-off. If you're reliable, disciplined, and take pride in premium work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor — Long-Form Performance Ads (Health Niche, 50+)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health niche, focused on building high-converting video ads for Meta.



We sell bamboo compression products — knee sleeves, ankle braces, gloves and socks — primarily targeting customers aged 50+ across European markets.



Our flagship product, DailyCompress, is a breathable bamboo knee sleeve with one key difference: it's designed to be worn through the night.



Here's why that matters. While you sleep, blood flow to the knee slows right down — so the joint stays stiff, swells, and never fully recovers, which is exactly why mornings feel so painful and stiff. DailyCompress applies gentle, even compression all night long to keep circulation going, flush out fluid and waste, and ease swelling and inflammation while you rest. You wake up with a more supple, less painful knee. On top of that: a perfect fit for every body and a sleeve that genuinely stays in place — for a group of people most braces were never designed for, and never designed to be worn in bed.



What we're really after (please read this carefully)



This is the most important part of the role, so we'll be direct about it.



Our biggest growth opportunity sits at the very top of the funnel — with cold, "unaware" and "problem-aware" audiences. These are people who feel knee pain and stiffness every single day, but who don't yet know what's actually causing it, and who have often never been diagnosed with anything. By far, this is our largest audience.



That means our ads can't open by shouting "arthritis." The 
nt we name a diagnosis, we shrink our reach to the small group that already self-identifies. Instead, our best-performing ads:



- Lead with a felt symptom or a relatable everyday 
nt (that first stiff step out of bed)

- Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never connected the dots on

- Then bridge naturally to the solution, the proof, and the offer



So we are specifically looking for an editor who can build long-form, top-of-funnel storytelling ads that educate and reframe — not just conversion edits for warm traffic. Our videos are getting longer, not shorter. The ability to hold a cold viewer's attention for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable skill you can bring to this role.



This is a senior role — we are not looking for a beginner. We need an experienced editor who has already made videos exactly like this and can prove it, not someone still learning the craft on the job. If you're early in your editing journey, this won't be the right fit, and that's completely okay.



What you'll be doing



- Edit long-form VSL ads (2–4+ minutes) designed to take cold, unaware/problem-aware audiences from "I have knee pain" all the way to purchase in a single watch

- Build narrative arcs: hook ? problem ? reframe ? solution ? proof ? CTA

- Edit with strong pacing for retention (cuts every 2–4 seconds, B-roll layering, captions, motion graphics)

- Work with clear customer avatars and structured creative briefs

- Translate written scripts and angles into emotionally engaging videos



What this role is NOT



We are not looking for someone who just "cuts clips together."



We're looking for someone who understands:



- why a 3-minute ad keeps a cold viewer watching all the way to the end

- how to layer B-roll, text, and music to build narrative tension across a longer story

- which 5 seconds matter most (the hook) and how to make them stop the scroll

- how pacing, captions, and visual rhythm affect retention and conversion

- how to edit differently for someone who is unaware of the cause versus someone who is ready to buy



Requirements



- Senior-level experience — you've already edited multiple long-form/VSL ads that have actually run on Meta. This is not a junior or entry-level role

- Proven experience editing VSL or long-form ad content for Meta 
/Instagram) — please share examples

- Strong skills in AI image and video generation — please share examples

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Pro (mention which tools you master)

- Solid understanding of direct response / performance marketing and awareness-stage thinking

- Ability to work from scripts and turn them into engaging visual stories

- Experience with captions, motion graphics, B-roll selection, and color grading

- Ability to source or work with provided stock footage, UGC, and brand assets

- Experience editing for the 50+ demographic is a strong plus

- Experience in the health, wellness, or supplements niche is a big plus

- Fluent English



What we offer



- Full-time position (8 hours per day)

- Long-term opportunity in a fast-growing company

- Clear systems, avatars, scripts and structured briefings

- Room to grow with the brand

- Direct collaboration with the creative strategist



How to apply



If you've read this carefully, start your message with the word "Editing" — applications that don't will be skipped.



Then send us the following:



1. Three (3) long-form video ads you've edited that target unaware or problem-aware (top of funnel) audiences, each at least minutes long. This is the most important part of your application — we want to see how you hold a cold viewer's attention and build a problem-aware story over a longer runtime.

2. At least 3 realistic AI-generated scenes of older adults (50+) used for storytelling in video ads.

3. In a few sentences, tell us why you're the right fit for this specific role — what makes you strong at long-form, problem-aware storytelling for an older audience, and not just at editing footage.

4. Review our product: 
/bamboe-kniebrace

5. Based on this product, briefly describe: 1 long-form VSL concept (2–3 minutes) you would edit, with a short outline of the narrative arc, aimed at an unaware/problem-aware cold audience

6. Tell us your editing tools and your typical turnaround time per video.



Thank you.



Best regards,

Ralph

title: Bookkeeper / Transaction Recorder — Luxury Watch Business
description:
Majestix Collection is a premier destination for buying, selling, and trading luxury timepieces.

We're looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper to accurately record every transaction that moves through our inventory — from the price we pay for a watch, through reconditioning and shipping, to the final sale and commission calculations.

This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys clean, accurate records and can follow a defined system without cutting corners. You'll be the single source of truth for our numbers, so precision and trustworthiness matter more than speed.

 

What you'll do 

1. Record what we pay for each watch

Every watch enters through our Sell/Trade form, which automatically feeds into our MJX Sales Tracker (Google Sheets) under the "Submit and Shoot" tab.

A thread is created for each watch in Zoho Cliq, where the amount paid is usually posted as a screenshot.

You'll be tagged when a value is ready to record, and you'll log the purchase price in the correct row.

 

2. Record Shipping, reconditioning and parts costs

When a watch is received and kept (not returned to the seller):

Move its row from the "Submit and Shoot" tab into the "Stock and Sold" tab, placing it above the "Sold" section.

Log the ship-in cost (we'll provide a rate sheet based on distance and insured value of the package).

Log polish, service, and parts costs.

Document what each cost is for using cell comments. When a single cost is made up of multiple components, use a formula (e.g. =value1+value2+value3) and describe each component in the cell comment.

 

3. Record the sale

When a watch sells, the final numbers come from the platform invoice (eBay, Chrono24) or our own customer invoice — found in the sales thread (Zoho Cliq) or under Payments > Invoices.

In the same row, record the initial amount we were paid.

Record every fee involved in the sale — taxes, shipping, additional parts, platform fees, and so on.

 

4. Calculate the commisions

Using the recorded numbers, calculate commissions for each tea
mber — both in the MJX Sales Tracker and in each employee's personal commission sheet.

This part of the role requires independence and discretion. You'll work directly with leadership and stay separate from the sales team, with no outside influence on the numbers. You'll have access to sensitive compensation data, so confidentiality and neutrality are non-negotiable.

 

What we're looking for:

 

Meticulous attention to detail and a genuine love for accurate, organized records

Comfortable in Google Sheets — formulas, cell comments, and structured multi-tab workbooks

Trustworthy and discreet; able to handle confidential financial and compensation data

Able to follow a defined workflow consistently and flag anything that doesn't add up

An independent worker who can stay objective and neutral

 

Nice to have:

 

Bookkeeping or accounting background

Experience with Zoho Books or QuickBooks

Familiarity with Zoho Cliq

Experience with e-commerce or marketplace sales (eBay, Chrono24)

title: Virtual Assistant / Practice Manager
description:
Looking for a Warm, Organized Practice Manager to Be the Heartbeat of a Growing Solo Counseling Practice

Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term | Room to Grow



 

 

About Me

I am a solo private-pay counseling practitioner based in the Philadelphia area, serving individuals and couples. I also deliver behavioral health training to organizations through a separate training division that I am actively growing. I am looking for a reliable, warm, and highly organized Virtual Executive Assistant to take full ownership of the operational side of my practice so I can focus entirely on my clients and my work.

I treat everyone I work with the same way I treat my clients — with genuine respect, patience, and care. If you bring your best to this role, you will be valued and supported in return.



About the Role

This is not a typical task-based VA position. You will be the primary point of contact for my clients — handling scheduling, billing, and direct communication by phone and text on behalf of my practice. You will also support my professional presence and growing training division.

You will work approximately 5–8 hours per week to start. Hours are flexible, with availability during US Eastern business hours required for client-facing communication.

This is a solo practice. You will work directly and exclusively with me. If you thrive in a structured corporate environment with multiple supervisors and team layers, this is probably not the right fit. If you prefer a close, direct working relationship where your contributions are visible and genuinely matter, keep reading.

Please note: This role involves handling confidential client information. Discretion and professionalism are non-negotiable. A Business Associate Agreement will be required before work begins.



 

What You’ll Own

Scheduling & Calendar

• Manage my practice calendar

• Handle all appointment requests, reschedules, and cancellations

• Maintain a client waitlist and proactively fill open slots

• Coordinate schedule adjustments around training engagements

• Schedule phone calls and external meetings around my availability and daily logistics, including travel time between locations and session blocks

Client Communication

• Respond to all client inquiries by phone and text via our shared business line

• Communicate warmly, professionally, and with genuine care

• Handle sensitive scheduling and billing conversations with discretion

Payment Management

• Process client payments directly through our practice management system

• Follow up on any failed or outstanding payments professionally

• Maintain accurate payment records

Clinical Admin

• Upload documents and notes to client profiles as directed

• Send assessments or scales to clients when instructed

• Add clinician comments to session records when requested

• No clinical judgment or decision-making is involved — you execute specific instructions precisely

Professional Presence

• Make minor updates to my practice website as needed

• Draft LinkedIn posts and website copy for my review and approval

• You are expected to use AI tools to work efficiently in this area — your judgment in refining and personalizing the output is what I value

Training Division Support

• Send outreach on behalf of my training division to prospective organizational clients

• Schedule introductory calls and demos

• Coordinate training logistics including venues, materials, and supplies

• Track leads and follow-up activity

• Draft outreach
s and follow-up sequences using AI tools for review before sending

 

 

You Are

• A warm, people-oriented communicator — clients feel genuinely cared for when they speak with you

• Highly organized and self-directed — you don’t wait to be told what to do next

• Comfortable owning outcomes, not just completing tasks

• Absolutely discreet — you understand the sensitivity of the information you will handle

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• Comfortable working in practice management software, billing systems, and Google Workspace

• Comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster

• Available during US Eastern business hours for at least a portion of your day

 

 

Work Schedule

This is a part-time remote position. Hours are flexible — approximately 5–8 hours per week to start, spread across weekdays. You will need to be reachable during US Eastern business hours for time-sensitive client communication. There are no rigid start or end times beyond that. Occasional personal tasks may be requested as the working relationship develops.

 

Compensation

Starting rate is $7 per hour, with increases tied to performance and role expansion. This is a long-term engagement — I am not looking for someone for a few months. I am looking for the right person to grow with me.

 

Career Potential

This role starts small — but it is a ground-floor opportunity in something actively being built. My training division is growing, and my long-term vision includes expanding into a full training business: delivering programs nationally, developing and selling curriculum, and hiring trainers across the country.

The right person who grows with this practice will grow with the business. As volume increases, hours increase. As the training division expands, so does your role and your rate. There is no ceiling on where this goes for someone who is reliable, trustworthy, and invested in what we are building.

 

To Apply

Please send a brief voice or video introduction of 2–3 minutes telling me who you are, what kind of work you have done, and why this role appeals to you. Written applications without a voice or video component will not be considered.

Please use the subject line: Practice Assistant — [Your Name].

title: TikTok Shop Account Specialist
description:

This role is ideal for someone who understands the TikTok Shop ecosystem, creator and affiliate collaborations, TikTok Ads Manager, marketplace syncing, and fulfillment coordination. We are looking for someone who is not only skilled, but also honest, trustworthy, proactive, and has the potential to grow into a leadership role.

TikTok Shop Account Management

Manage daily TikTok Seller Center operations.

Monitor product listings, pricing, promotions, inventory, orders, account health, violations, and fulfillment performance.

Make sure listings are active, optimized, and properly synced across TikTok Shop, Shopify, and other approved marketplaces.

Track TikTok Shop performance, including GMV, orders, conversion rate, ad sales, creator sales, refunds, cancellations, and profitability.

Creator, Affiliate, and Collaboration Management

Recruit, communicate with, and manage TikTok creators, affiliates, and collaborators.

Set up and monitor affiliate campaigns, commissions, free samples, and collaboration requests.

Prioritize creators based on content quality, audience fit, GMV potential, and past performance.

Follow up with creators for video posting, live selling, product reviews, and campaign participation.

Maintain a creator tracker with sample status, shipped units, posted videos, sales, and next action.

Manage budgets, targeting, creatives, product ads, video shopping ads, and retargeting campaigns.

Review ad performance and recommend actions based on ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, spend, and sales.

Prevent stockouts, overselling, sample delays, cancellations, and fulfillment issues.

Shopify and Marketplace Integration

Reporting and Growth Strategy

Experience creating SOPs, trackers, and performance dashboards.

Honest and trustworthy.

Proactive and organized.

Detail-oriented.

Interested in growing with the company long term.

Increased TikTok Shop GMV.
